note: Adjudicated accidental variants (punctuation). Substantive text agrees across both witnesses with zero variants.

adjudicated.ruling: No comma inside the string of appositions naming the Son, with handmissal-eo and with the corpus rulings at ordinarium.confiteor w064 and ordinarium.aufer-a-nobis w018: Jesus Christus Fílius tuus Dóminus noster is one unbroken title, and cutting it once would require cutting it twice.
No comma before the second apposition, with handmissal-eo — parallel to w031 in the same title.

No comma before the trailing Deus, with DO: Deus is in apposition to the subject Qui, the same construction the corpus leaves unbroken at w031, and a comma here would read as though a new address began.
